title: A novel approach reveals genomic landscapes of single-strand DNA breaks with nucleotide resolution in human cells
protocol: Collect 2-4 ml of peripheral blood in EDTA anti-coagulation tubes and mix well by gently inverting the tube several times.
Dilute the samples with equal volume of 1× PBS at room temperature.
Take Solarbio Lymphocyte Separation Medium into a 15 ml centrifuge tube (add 3 ml when the diluted blood volume is less than 3 ml, add equal volume for volumes greater than 3 ml).
Gently layer the diluted blood on top of Solarbio Lymphocyte Separation Medium very slowly to keep as two different layers.
Centrifuge the samples for 30 min at 1000g at 25°C in the 5804R centrifuge with acceleration and brake settings of 6 and 0 respectively.
Carefully aspirate the PBMCs formed in the interphase into a new 15 ml tube.
Add 10 ml of sterile 1× PBS into the tube with the aspirate, gently resuspend the aspirate and then centrifuge at 250g at 25°C for 10 min.
Remove the supernatant and repeat the last step.
After the centrifugation, resuspend the aspirate in 1-2 ml of sterile 1× PBS, count the PBMCs while keeping cells on ice.
Inactivate trypsin with the growth medium containing serum.
Centrifuge cells at 100 g for 5 minutes at 4°C to remove the growth medium with serum.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells in fresh growth medium with serum.
Start with 1-3 million non-adherent or adherent cells or 4-6 million PBMCs in 1-2 ml of either growth medium with serum or 1× PBS in a new 2 ml Eppendorf tube.
Add 27 µl of 37% formaldehyde per 1 ml of cell culture medium or PBS while gently shaking for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Add 100 µl of 1.375 M glycine per milliliter to quench formaldehyde, mixing well by inverting the tube several times for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge cells at 220 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and wash the cells twice with 2 ml of cold 1× PBS at 220 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 2 ml of cold cell lysis buffer, pipetting up and down to separate them completely.
Incubate the cells for 10 minutes on ice.
Centrifuge the nuclei at 300 g in a benchtop centrifuge for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully.
Wash the pellet with 500 µl cold 1× MNase buffer, centrifuge for 10 min at 4°C at 300 g.
Repeat steps to aspirate the supernatant and wash the pellet as described previously.
Resuspend the pellet by adding 100 µl 1× MNase buffer if nuclei are to be stored at -80°C, then store directly or proceed with processing.
Thaw frozen samples on ice until completely thawed when ready to use.
Centrifuge the sample for 10 min at 4°C at 300 g after thawing and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet completely in 100 µl of 1× MNase buffer if proceeding with SDS permeabilization.
Add 3 µl of 10% SDS into the tube.
Gently pipette up and down while moving around the tip to mix the SDS well, achieving a final concentration of 0.3%.
Slowly shake at 300 rpm for 1 hour at 37°C in the thermostatic metal bath.
Slowly add 1.8 µl of Triton X-100 into the solution.
Gently pipette up and down while moving around the tip to mix Triton X-100 well, achieving a final concentration of 1.8%.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature to sequester SDS.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 1500 g with the temperature setting of 27°C in a high-speed refrigerated centrifuge.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully and completely.
Wash the pellet with 500 µl of 1× MNase buffer.
Repeat step 4 (centrifugation).
Aspirate the supernatant carefully and completely again.
Repeat the washing step (step 5) if complete precipitation is not achieved initially.
Use the nuclei for the following step after aspirating the supernatant carefully.
Wash the permeabilized nuclei with 500 µl of 1× NEB buffer 2.1.
Gently resuspend the permeabilized nuclei and centrifuge at 1500 g at 27°C for 10 min in a high-speed refrigerated centrifuge.
Carefully remove the supernatant and repeat step 1.
Remove the supernatant, resuspend the nuclei in 50 µl of 1× NEB buffer 2.1.
Add 1 µl SAP into the solution.
Treat the nuclei in 50 µl of 1× NEB buffer 2.1 with 1U of SAP for 2h at 37°C in a thermostatic metal bath.
Inactivate enzyme by incubation at 70°C for 20 min in a thermostatic metal bath.
Centrifuge the nuclei at 1500 g at 27°C for 10 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully and completely.
Wash the pellet twice with 500 µl of 1× MNase buffer by centrifuging at 1500 g at 27°C for 10 minutes each time.
Remove the supernatant after washing.
Resuspend the nuclei in 50 µl of cold 1× MNase buffer supplemented with 200 μg/ml BSA per 1 million nuclei.
Split the sample into aliquots of 1 million nuclei per 0.2 ml PCR tube.
Add 1200-3000 units of MNase and 25 units of RNase I to each aliquot.
Mix the solution well by pipetting up and down.
Incubate for 30 minutes on ice.
Add 5.6 µl of 0.5 M EDTA into the solution slowly, mixing by pipetting up and down.
Add 150 µl of nuclei lysis buffer to each tube and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Add 1 µl of 20 mg/ml proteinase K to the mixture and incubate at 55°C for 45 minutes in a PCR thermocycler.
Incubate the mixture at 65°C for 45 minutes in a PCR thermocycler.
Transfer the samples to 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes.
Add 20 µl of 3 M KCl solution and 176 µl of cold isopropanol.
Vortex for 5 seconds, then incubate for 30 minutes at -80°C.
Thaw the samples at room temperature and centrifuge for 15 minutes at 4°C (or 10 minutes at maximum speed at 4°C).
Remove the supernatant, then add 100 µl of ice-cold 70% ethanol into the tube.
Vortex for 5 seconds, then centrifuge the tube for 5 minutes at maximum speed at room temperature.
Repeat steps removing supernatant and adding ethanol, vortexing and centrifuging.
Aspirate the supernatant completely and carefully.
Vacuum-dry the DNA pellet for 2 minutes in the Eppendorf Concentrator plus or at room temperature for 5-10 minutes.
Dissolve the DNA pellet in 20 µl UltraPure™ DNase/RNase-Free Distilled Water and transfer to a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Pre-warm VAHTS DNA Clean Beads for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Add double volume (40 µl) ratio of VAHTS DNA Clean Beads suspension to the DNA.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down approximately 20 times.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place the tube on the 1.5 ml magnetic rack to separate beads from the supernatant.
When the solution is clear (~5 minutes), aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the tube with the sample while on the magnetic stand (keep the beads together).
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat steps 23-24 once for a total of twice washing.
Briefly spin the tube.
Put the tube back in the magnetic rack.
Remove the residual ethanol completely with a 10 μl tip.
Air dry the beads (~5 min).
Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and add 17 μl of nuclease-free water.
Mix well by pipetting up and down 30-40 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Put the tube in the magnetic rack until the solution is clear (~5 min).
Carefully remove 16 μl of the supernatant and transfer to a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Measure the DNA concentration using Qubit 3.0 fluorometer and “dsDNA HS Assay” kit.
Check the DNA products on 1% agarose gel or BioAnalyzer to ensure that the majority of DNA is in the range of 150-500 bp.
Transfer 100 ng of the purified fragmented DNA into a 0.2 ml Axygen RNase/DNase free PCR tube.
Add 10× TdT buffer: 2 µl.
Add 2.5 mM CoCl₂: 2 µl.
Add nuclease-free water to make the total volume of 19 µl.
Denature the mixture at 95°C for 5 min followed by rapid snap-cooling on ice.
Dilute TdT (20 U/µl) to 4 U/µl with 1× TdT buffer.
Mix 4 U/μl TdT with 1 μl.
Add 2 μl of 10 mM dATP to the mixture.
Mix gently without vortexing.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes and keep at 4°C.
Add 2 μl of 10 mM ddCTP, ddGTP, ddATP, or ddTTP to block tailing.
Mix gently but thoroughly without vortexing.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes and then at 70°C for 10 minutes.
Keep the mixture at 4°C.
Pre-warm VAHTS DNA Clean Beads for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Add double volume (48 μl) of VAHTS DNA Clean Beads suspension to the polyA-tailing mixture.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down approximately 20 times.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place the tube on a magnetic rack to separate beads from supernatant.
Discard the supernatant when it is clear.
Add 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the tube with the sample while on the magnetic stand.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat steps above once for a total of twice washing.
Briefly spin the tube.
Put the tube back in the magnetic rack.
Remove residual ethanol completely with a 10 μl tip.
Air dry the beads (~5 min).
Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and add 18 μl of nuclease-free water.
Mix well by pipetting up and down 30-40 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Put the tube in the magnetic rack until the solution is clear (~5 min).
Transfer 16.2 μl of supernatant to a new 0.2 ml PCR tube carefully.
Add 10× PCR buffer: 2 µl to the eluted DNA from the previous step.
Add 10 mM dNTP mix: 0.4 µl to the reaction mixture.
Add 10 μM of a chimeric DNA-RNA oligo-d(T)50-r(T)3 oligonucleotide: 1 µl to the mixture.
Add Taq DNA polymerase: 0.4 µl to complete the reaction setup.
Incubate at 94°C for 30 sec in a thermocycler with lid set at 105 °C.
Incubate at 94°C for 1 min.
Incubate at 55°C for 30 sec.
Incubate at 72°C for 30 sec.
Loop back to step of incubating at 94°C for 1 min and repeat the cycle parameters 9 times, for a total of 10 cycles.
Rapidly snap-cool on ice to prevent non-specific extension.
Pre-warm VAHTS DNA Clean Beads for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Add double volume (40 μl) ratio of VAHTS DNA Clean Beads suspension to the polyA-tailing mixture.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down approximately 20 times.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place the tube on the 1.5 ml magnetic rack to separate beads from the supernatant.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant when the solution is clear (~5 min).
Add 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the tube with the sample while on the magnetic stand (keep the beads together).
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat steps adding 80% ethanol and incubating for a total of twice washing.
Briefly spin the tube, and put the tube back in the magnetic rack.
Remove residual ethanol completely with a 10 μl tip.
Air dry the beads (~5 min).
Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and add 16 μl of nuclease-free water.
Mix well by pipetting up and down 30-40 times, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Put the tube in the magnetic rack until the solution is clear (~5 min).
Transfer 15 μl of the supernatant to a new 0.2 ml PCR tube carefully.
Mix 2 µl of 10× TdT buffer into the denatured mixture.
Add 2 µl of 2.5 mM CoCl₂ to the mixture.
Dilute TdT from 20 U/µl to 4 U/µl with 1× buffer.
Add 1 µl of 4 U/µl TdT to the mixture.
Add 2 µl of 10 mM dCTP to the mixture.
Mix gently and incubate at 37°C for 30 min in a PCR thermocycler.
Add 2 µl of 10 mM ddCTP, ddGTP, ddATP or ddTTP to block the tails.
Mix gently and incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Incubate at 70°C for 10 min after blocking.
Pre-warm VAHTS DNA Clean Beads for 30 min at room temperature.
Add double volume of VAHTS DNA Clean Beads suspension (48 µl) to the polyA-tailing mixture.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down ~20 times.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the tube on a 1.5 ml magnetic rack to separate beads from supernatant.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant when the solution is clear (~5 min).
Add 200 µl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the tube with the sample while on the magnetic stand.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat steps Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, and then carefully remove and discard the supernatant once for a total of twice washing.
Briefly spin the tube.
Put the tube back in the magnetic rack.
Remove the residual ethanol completely with a 10 μl tip.
Air dry the beads (~5 min).
Remove the tube from the magnetic rack.
Add 16.5 μl of nuclease-free water to the tube.
Mix well by pipetting up and down 30-40 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Put the tube in the magnetic rack until the solution is clear (~5 min).
Transfer 15.2 μl of the supernatant to a new 0.2 ml PCR tube carefully.
Mix 2 μl of 10× PCR buffer with polyC-tailed DNA.
Add 0.4 µl of 10 mM dNTP mix to the mixture.
Pipette 1 μl of 10 μM P5_G10 or P5_N10G10 oligonucleotide into the solution.
Mix 1 μl of 10 μM P7_T12 oligonucleotide with the existing components.
Add 0.4 µl of Taq DNA polymerase to complete the reaction mix.
Incubate at 94°C for 3 min.
Cycle at 94°C for 30 sec.
Incubate at 55°C for 1 min.
Heat at 72°C for 1 min.
Incubate at 94°C for 30 sec.
Warm up to 37°C for 1 min.
Ramp slowly from 37°C to 72°C at 2°C per minute, incubating at 72°C for 2 min.
Cycle back to 94°C for 30 sec.
Incubate at 60°C for 30 sec.
Heat at 72°C for 30 sec.
Repeat steps from 8) to 10) a total of 29 times.
Incubate at 72°C for 7 min.
Hold at 4 °C.
Pre-warm VAHTS DNA Clean Beads for 30 min at room temperature.
Add double volume (40 µl) ratio of VAHTS DNA Clean Beads suspension to the polyA-tailing mixture.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down ~20 times.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the tube on a 1.5 ml magnetic rack to separate beads from supernatant.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant when clear (~5 min).
Add 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the tube with the sample while on the magnetic stand.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat steps from 9-10 once more for a total of two washes.
Briefly spin the tube.
Remove residual ethanol completely with a 10 μl tip.
Air dry the beads for approximately 5 minutes.
Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and add 18 μl of nuclease-free water.
Mix well by pipetting up and down 30-40 times, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Put the tube in the magnetic rack until the solution is clear (~5 min).
Transfer 17 μl of the supernatant to a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube carefully.
Prepare PCR reaction by adding:
The eluted DNA from the previous step: 4 μl
10× PCR buffer: 2 μl
2.5 mM dNTP mix: 1.6 µl
10 μM Illumina-P5 primer oligonucleotide: 1 μl
10 μM Illumina-P7 primer oligonucleotide: 1 µl
Taq DNA polymerase: 0.4 µl
Nuclease-free water: 10 µl
Cycle parameters with the lid set at 105 °C:
94°C for 3 minutes.
Repeat cycles of 94°C for 30 seconds, 55°C for 30 seconds, and 72°C for 30 seconds five times.
After cycle repetition, incubate at 72°C for 7 minutes.
Hold at 4 °C.
Pre-warm VAHTS DNA Clean Beads for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Add double volume (40 µl) ratio of VAHTS DNA Clean Beads suspension to the polyA-tailing mixture.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down ~20 times.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place the tube on the 1.5 ml magnetic rack to separate beads from the supernatant.
When the solution is clear (~5 min), aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the tube with the sample while on the magnetic stand (keep the beads together).
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, and then carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Repeat steps above once for a total of twice washing.
Briefly spin the tube, and put the tube back in the magnetic rack.
Remove the residual ethanol completely with a 10 μl tip.
Air dry the beads (~5 min).
Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and add 22 μl of nuclease-free water.
Mix well by pipetting up and down 30-40 times, incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Put the tube in the magnetic rack until the solution is clear (~5 min).
Transfer 21 μl of the supernatant to a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube carefully.
Measure the DNA concentration using Qubit 3.0 fluorometer and “dsDNA HS Assay” kit.
At this stage, the samples can be stored for at least 1 year in -80°C, however, we usually send them for sequencing as soon as possible.
Filter the reads such that each read has a Phred quality score > 20 and length > 30.
Run fastq_quality_trimmer -v -t 20 -l 30 -i read_1.clean.fq -o read_1.clean.fq.1 -Q33
Run fastq_quality_trimmer -v -t 20 -l 30 -i read_2.clean.fq -o read_2.clean.fq.1 -Q33
Select read pairs where reads 1 start with 10 G’s or AGTTGCGGATGGGGGGGGGG in the NovaSeq protocol and reads 2 start with 12 T's.
Run perl 1_filter_paired.flags.pl read_1.clean.fq.1 read_2.clean.fq.1 GGGGGGGGGG TTTTTTTTTTTT
Run perl 1_filter_paired.flags.pl read_1.clean.fq.1 read_2.clean.fq.1 AGTTGCGGATGGGGGGGGGG TTTTTTTTTTTT
Map the reads to the desired reference genome.
Build the genome index using bwa index Human19.fasta –p HG19.
Map the reads using bwa mem –t 8 -M -R '@RG\tID:foo\tSM:bar\tLB:library1' HG19 read_1.clean.fq.1.trim read_2.clean.fq.1.trim > read.sam.

Filter the alignments by extracting only unique and proper mapped paired reads, then extract the alignment records of reads 2 containing the coordinates of breaks using perl 3_filter.sam.pl read.sam >read.proper.sam 2>log.3.
Convert the SAM file to a BED file and then extract the very first position of each aligned record of reads 2 using sh 4_sam2bed.right.proper.sh read.proper.sam read.candidates.bed 2>log.4.
Filter the alignments based on the fraction of T’s in the 20-base genomic sequence 5′ upstream of the reads 2 alignments using perl 5_filtering.internal.polyA.pl read
Extract the coordinates of breaks from read.bed.
Filter and process lines where $6 == "+" to generate read.break.bed.minus.
Filter and process lines where $6 == "-" to generate read.break.bed.plus.
Sort combined read.break.bed.plus and read.break.bed.minus into read.break.bed.
Remove temporary files read.break.bed.minus and read.break.bed.plus.
